from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

with sync_playwright() as playwright:
    browser = playwright.chromium.connect_over_cdp("http://localhost:9222/")
    page = browser.contexts[0].pages[0]

    # Navigate to Find Owners section
    page.goto("http://localhost:8080/")
    page.click("a:has-text('Find Owners')")

    # Search for owner with last name "Cooper"
    page.fill("input[name='lastName']", "Cooper")
    page.click("button:has-text('Find')")

    # Verify that no owner exists
    assert "No owners found" in page.content() or "no such owner" in page.content().lower()

    # Navigate to Add Owners section
    page.click("a:has-text('Add Owners')")

    # Add a new pet owner
    page.fill("input[name='firstName']", "Angelina")
    page.fill("input[name='lastName']", "Cooper")
    page.fill("input[name='address']", "357 Second Street")
    page.fill("input[name='city']", "Chicago")
    page.fill("input[name='phone']", "6095366426")
    page.click("button:has-text('Add')")

    # Navigate back to Find Owners section
    page.click("a:has-text('Find Owners')")

    # Search for owner with last name "Cooper" again
    page.fill("input[name='lastName']", "Cooper")
    page.click("button:has-text('Find')")

    # Verify that the owner "Angelina Cooper" is shown
    assert "Angelina Cooper" in page.content()

    print(page.url)
    print(page.content())
```
